changelog: Fixed a real porting bug in the FSA Gate 1 engine (app/js/structure-gate1.js), caught by the first real Pine-exported fixture set (BTC/LINK/LIT/PUMPFUN, TradingView v4.2): hiSince()/loSince() picked the wrong swing candle on a tie (two candles sharing the exact same extreme price within a scan range). Traced against the Pine source's actual relative-index semantics (low[i]/high[i] = i bars back from the confirming candle) rather than the higher-level prose description -- Pine seeds its scan from the CONFIRMING candle itself and walks backward, replacing only on strict improvement, so a tie keeps the LATER (closer to the confirming candle) of the two tied candles. The engine's port had done a forward scan from the start of the range instead, which silently kept the EARLIER tied candle -- same extreme value, wrong swingIdx. No rule change -- same ATR/zigzag/state-machine logic as v3.24.0, this only fixes which candle gets credited as the swing when two candles tie exactly.
release_notes: All 4 real fixtures (app/tests/fixtures/gate1/{BTCUSDT,LINKUSDT,LITUSDT,PUMPFUNUSDT}.json, exported from the actual TradingView indicator) now pass app/tests/gate1_parity.js exactly -- 5928 assertions, 0 failures (up from 1 failure pre-fix: LINKUSDT swing[180].swingIdx, a tie between candles 1531 and 1533 both at low=9.061, expected 1533/got 1531). Full regression sweep re-run after the fix since structure-gate1.js is live product code, not test-only: every harness driver (drive.mjs through drive-v3240.mjs) passes, duplicate-name scan clean, backtest_engine.php self-test 104/104, node --check clean. Fixture files themselves are not deployed (app/tests/ is dev-only, same as tools/ui-harness/ -- never listed in this manifest).
